# WO-2026-08-12-B15-VISION-PROTOTYPE-02 — Fix the tool-call continuation protocol

## Acceptance criteria

AC1 (= acceptance_property): In `visionAgenticTurn()` (`models.mjs`), when continuing a conversation
after a turn that produced one or more tool calls, construct a `function_call_output` item for EACH
pending `call_id` before sending the next request — not a single generic continuation. Read the real
captured shape at `Deliverables/2026-08-12-capability-probe-evidence/toolcall2-results.json` and
Asdair's live capture (this session's transcript) for the exact `output` array shape the Responses API
actually returned, and build the continuation input to match what the API expects to receive back, not
a guess at the general Responses API convention.

AC2: In `agenticLoop.js`, handle ALL of `result.toolCalls`, not just `result.toolCalls[0]`. Asdair's live
run showed Terra requesting two regions simultaneously in one turn — the loop must supply crops and
`function_call_output` items for every requested region before continuing, not silently drop any.

AC3: **Prove both with a mocked-response test shaped exactly like the real captured multi-call turn**
(two simultaneous `request_crop` function_call items, per the real evidence cited in AC1) — assert the
loop's NEXT outgoing request contains a `function_call_output` for each of the two `call_id`s, and that
the loop successfully continues to a final answer in the mock, not just past the first turn. This is the
acceptance_property; a single-call fixture is not sufficient proof, per the exact gap that let the first
version through.

AC4: Re-run AC3 (round 1's own prototype WO) with a single-tool-call mocked turn too, to confirm the
fix doesn't regress the simpler case.

AC5: All touched-package tests pass with a non-zero executed count. No live gateway call anywhere in
this WP's own test run.

## Required evidence

- The exact diff showing the `function_call_output` construction, and confirmation it matches the real
  captured API shape, not an assumed one.
- AC3's test output, pasted — the two-call continuation case succeeding to a final answer.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/obsidiwikai/src/core/models.mjs services/asdair/pipeline/agenticVisionPrototype` → exit code and coverage.

## Inputs supplied

- `Deliverables/2026-08-12-capability-probe-evidence/` — the real, committed probe evidence.
- Asdair's live-run report, this session's transcript — the exact captured turn-1 output shape (two
  simultaneous `request_crop` calls) and the exact 400 error text, both real evidence of what needs to
  be produced and what currently fails.
- Your own round-1 prototype code (`agenticLoop.js`, `visionAgenticTurn()` in `models.mjs`) — read it
  fresh before changing it.

## Explicitly out of scope — report, never fix

- Running this against the live gateway yourself — Asdair's job, once this lands.
- The region-plan granularity finding (3 regions total for this photo) — a separate question, not this
  WP's fix.
- The "resend same crop, not fresh higher-resolution render" limitation — unchanged, a separate design
  question for later, not this fix.
- The `sharp` dependency not being installed in this worktree (Asdair's workaround, disclosed in its
  report) — report if it affects you, don't fix the worktree setup itself as part of this WP.
- Wiring into production, any model change, `services/cockpit/**`, any live shop/browser/basket action.

## Sequencing

1. Standard gate: read back (outcome, plan, what this order failed to settle, what looks wrong) and HOLD for Larry's explicit acceptance before writing any code.
2. On acceptance: implement AC1/AC2 together (they're the same continuation-construction logic), prove with AC3/AC4, then AC5.
3. Report completion with the required evidence above. Larry will then dispatch Asdair for another live run — the one that should actually reach a scoreable final answer.
